workshoptitle: Product Recall Assistant: Automate Secure Returns Decisions

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: See Kevin’s returns outcome, David’s architecture, and Tim’s eight-lab implementation.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Keep Recall Reports and Case Decisions Together with JSON
tutorials.description: Kevin needs one B-482 case record; David keeps the application report and case status together, and Tim opens the case.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Put Help Where It Is Needed: Map Recall Impact with Oracle Spatial
tutorials.description: Kevin needs a return-response plan; David designs location-aware coverage, and Tim assigns each affected store to a nearby center.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Find the Source and the Reach: Trace Recall Paths with SQL Property Graph
tutorials.description: Kevin needs cause-to-exposure traceability; David models connected paths, and Tim traces lots, suppliers, stores, and customers.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Find Related Complaints: Use AI Vector Search for B-482
tutorials.description: Kevin needs complaints that describe the B-482 heat and odor issue; David keeps vector search with recall data, and Tim returns the relevant complaint details.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Give the Returns Desk Reliable Answers with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Kevin needs reliable returns-desk answers without direct table access; David limits the assistant to package functions, and Tim registers the tools.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Share Recall Data Safely with ORDS
tutorials.description: Kevin needs an affected-store map; David separates API access from table access, and Tim builds a GeoJSON function and publishes a protected ORDS endpoint.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Give Each User the Right Recall Scope with Deep Data Security
tutorials.description: Kevin needs each role to see only its own recall records; David puts authorization in the database, and Tim compares the results.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Run Secure Returns from One React Application
tutorials.description: Kevin needs one returns application; David keeps the database rules in place, and Tim brings each user's authorized results into React.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Template to link to Need Help lab at the end of workshop.
